operating_state: Enabled and active. The completed oneshot retains its active state.
actual_order: The guard runs after network-online, the ruleset loader and the container engine. The engine was active when the guard last started. The engine and ruleset loader both want the guard; both propagate stop/restart through PartOf. The ruleset loader also propagates reload.
input_dependency: The installed helper matches the recorded implementation. In its active engine-discovery mode, it identifies the registered pool using the live container publication, verifies the selected scope, and then applies the separate ingress restriction. A publication must already be visible for discovery to succeed.
exposure_window: Publication can precede protection on startup. No restart or live timing test was performed and no duration is established. The previous blocked external readback applies to steady state.
proposed_change_for_owner: Use a root-managed persistent rule for the already registered second ingress scope, independent of Docker runtime inventory. Load it before Docker is allowed to publish, with a fail-closed start dependency and a check of the exact rule. Preserve the separate first restriction and the existing management and messaging routes. Apply ruleset reloads atomically, then validate ordering, scope and steady-state reachability from the same external observer after owner authorization.
